_comment: Desired state for the CDL VAPI assistants. Source of truth — edit here, then
run `python scripts/deploy_vapi.py` to diff and `--apply` to push.
Only the keys listed here are managed; anything else on the assistant is left
untouched. server.url is deliberately NOT managed yet: it still points at the
n8n Cloud host, and gets repointed once the merged workflow exists on the

fullName.description: Caller's full name, empty string if not given

phoneNumber.description: Callback number in E.164 if determinable, else as spoken

zipCode.description: US 5-digit ZIP, empty string if not given

experience.description: Exact tractor-trailer experience stated by the caller, preserving the numeric amount and unit, for example 5+ years or 18 months. Use unknown only when no amount was provided.

preferredCallbackTime.description: ISO 8601 local time if given, else empty string

bookingConfirmed.description: True only if the tool confirmed a booking

new-lead.name: CDL Recruiting Agency - New Lead
new-lead.firstMessage: Hey, thanks for calling Frontline CDL Staffing! Just so you know, this call is recorded so our recruiters can follow up. Are you calling about a driving job today?

existing-lead.name: CDL Recruiting Agency - Existing Lead
existing-lead.firstMessage: Hey {{ name | default: "there" }}, thanks for calling Frontline CDL Staffing! Just so you know, this call is recorded so our recruiters can follow up. How can I help you today?
